entries.title: Psalms 144:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Blessed [be] the LORD my Rock, Who trains my hands for war, [And] my fingers for battle-

entries.title: Psalms 144:2
segments: My lovingkindness and my fortress, My high tower and my deliverer, My shield and [the One] in whom I take refuge, Who subdues my people under me.

entries.title: Psalms 144:3
segments: LORD, what [is] man, that You take knowledge of him? [Or] the son of man, that You are mindful of him?

entries.title: Psalms 144:4
segments: Man is like a breath; His days [are] like a passing shadow.

entries.title: Psalms 144:5
segments: Bow down Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 144:6
segments: Flash forth lightning and scatter them; Shoot out Your arrows and destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 144:7
segments: Stretch out Your hand from above; Rescue me and deliver me out of great waters, From the hand of foreigners,

entries.title: Psalms 144:8
segments: Whose mouth speaks vain words, And whose right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 144:9
segments: ¶I will sing a new song to You, O God; On a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to You,

entries.title: Psalms 144:10
segments: [The One] who gives salvation to kings, Who delivers David His servant From the deadly sword.

entries.title: Psalms 144:11
segments: Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreigners, Whose mouth speaks lying words, And whose right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood-

entries.title: Psalms 144:12
segments: That our sons [may be] as plants grown up in their youth; [That] our daughters [may be] as pillars, Sculptured in palace style;

entries.title: Psalms 144:13
segments: [That] our barns [may be] full, Supplying all kinds of produce; [That] our sheep may bring forth thousands And ten thousands in our fields;

entries.title: Psalms 144:14
segments: [That] our oxen [may be] well-laden; [That there be] no breaking in or going out; [That there be] no outcry in our streets.

entries.title: Psalms 144:15
segments: Happy [are] the people who are in such a state; Happy [are] the people whose God [is] the LORD!
